# Calibration of the v2 inference (generated by `scripts/calibrate_v2.py`, 1488 s)

Every campaign ran through the real engine (per-agent logins, gateway, RLS, scoring views, signed freeze) on a separate database.
Rates are shown with exact 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals.

## N. No leak anywhere: family-wise false alarms over every claim (600 campaigns, 36 hypotheses each)

| alpha | any false LEAK (all claims) | any false LEAK (agent gates only) | FWER <= alpha |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.05 | 2.0% [1.0, 3.5] | 2.0% [1.0, 3.5] | True |
| 0.01 | 0.2% [0.0, 0.9] | 0.2% [0.0, 0.9] | True |
| 0.001 | 0.0% [0.0, 0.6] | 0.0% [0.0, 0.6] | True |

Without any multiplicity control, some cell would show p <= 0.05 in 25.7% [22.2, 29.4] of these leak-free campaigns.

## S. No leak, watched after every slot (300 campaigns, up to 320 slots, 2 stopped early)

| procedure | false LEAK rate | nominal alpha |
|---|---|---|
| anytime e-values, engine stops at first flag (v2) | 0.7% [0.1, 2.4] | 0.05 |
| naive: exact fixed-n test after every slot | 13.3% [9.7, 17.7] | 0.05 |

Naive peeking flags every campaign the e-values flag, and many more: True.

## P. Power: the same campaigns scored by the v2 and the v1 procedure (152 slots, 2x2x2)

### strong (trust 0.9: accuracy 0.95 when exposed) (200 campaigns)

| agent | v2 agent gate | v1: any cell, flat Holm over 24 |
|---|---|---|
| trader-clean | 0.5% [0.0, 2.8] | 2.5% [0.8, 5.7] |
| trader-leaky | 100.0% [98.2, 100.0] | 100.0% [98.2, 100.0] |
| trader-partial | 100.0% [98.2, 100.0] | 100.0% [98.2, 100.0] |

| channel test (matched pairs) | flagged |
|---|---|
| trader-partial:vector_memory | 100.0% [98.2, 100.0] |
| trader-partial:notes_table | 0.0% [0.0, 1.8] |
| trader-partial:cache | 0.5% [0.0, 2.8] |
| trader-leaky:vector_memory | 27.5% [21.4, 34.2] |
| trader-leaky:notes_table | 30.0% [23.7, 36.9] |
| trader-leaky:cache | 26.5% [20.5, 33.2] |

Any false LEAK on trader-clean: 0.5% [0.0, 2.8].

## T. Slots to detection, sequential, trust 0.4 (150 campaigns)

Slots used: median 88 (10th-90th percentile 32-184) of up to 400; trader-leaky detected in 94.7% [89.8, 97.7]. A fixed-n exact test at the same level needs n = 71 for 80% power.

**Overall: PASS**
